answer: A basalt is written into the terrace only after delivering river, hours of novel work graded by randomly drawn reviewers, and the n-th basalt admitted in any epoch must deliver n river on one counter shared by all. The terrace fingerprints graded work, so near-identical clones collide there and are voided. An honest entrant in a quiet epoch delivers about 5 river; a farm adding 1,000 basalt in one epoch delivers about 500,000, or waits 200 epochs. It breaks if graders are bribed or work is cheaply paraphrased.
